name: quantelune
description: Local-first research workspace for tables, coded materials and time-based media.

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate
